title: UTCS Provider Attestation
description: Every UTCS response includes an attestation block identifying who calculated the tax, using what content, and when. Ensures auditability.

provider_id.description: Unique identifier of the UTCS provider.

content_version.description: Version of the tax content/rules database used for this calculation.

calculation_timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the calculation was performed.

engine_version.description: Version of the provider's calculation engine.

signature.description: Optional digital signature over the response payload. Enables cryptographic verification of the result.
